verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic surfaces an AI-native user could script to act on many items: REST API create/read/update/delete over JSON, official client libraries, WC-CLI for managing stores from the command line, and native MCP support. However, no item explicitly documents batch endpoints, bulk-edit actions, or multi-item operations, so bulk capability is only implied by scripting these interfaces. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, documented bulk edit for products or orders in the dashboard, CLI or MCP bulk-operation examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
